messages:
deploybot: Build pipeline started for tag v2.8.0 (commit: f2a9c3b) on staging
ci-bot: build ✅ (steps: install, compile)
maria: lint step failing on staging - seen in CI logs, posting error below
ci-bot: 
```
/workspace/packages/ui/src/button.tsx:12:8 Error - 'noop' is defined but never used. (no-unused-vars)
1 error
```
sam: ugh that rule just started failing after the eslint upgrade in #PR-412, likely the new rule config is stricter
jess: do we want to pin eslint back or change the rule? we need a decision fast, canary is on deck in 20m
thao: if we pin, that's safe but might hide legit issues. We could patch package.json to pin eslint to 8.37 and run quick rerun
maria: quick patch diff: "eslint": "8.37.0" in root package.json then `yarn install` and re-run pipeline. low risk for staging only
sam: alternative: add `/* eslint-disable no-unused-vars */` around the impacted file but that's hacky
release-manager: what's the impact if we skip lint on CI for this run? canary still useful to verify runtime
jess: skipping lint would shorten time but bypass checks. For a minor UI tweak in this release, I'm leaning skip+post-release followup if we can lock the version now
ci-bot: rerun requested by maria — yarn install + pipeline retry queued
ci-bot: lint ❌ (no-unused-vars) — same file
maria: quick follow: I pushed a dependency-pin commit cherry-pick -> commit: b7d4e11, requesting pipeline rerun
deploybot: Triggered rerun for commit b7d4e11 on staging (initiated by maria)
ci-bot: lint ✅, tests ✅, build ✅
release-manager: OK great. Decision: pin eslint for this release, add a follow-up ticket to re-evaluate the rule for next minor. Can we get a note in the release notes?
jess: noted — adding to release notes: "Pin eslint to 8.37.0 to avoid transient rule breakage; rule review scheduled for v2.9.0"
thao: creating ticket ENG-1289 to track rule audit and plan
sam: thumbs up. rolling canary in 10m :shipit:
deploybot: Canary deploy started for tag v2.8.0 (commit b7d4e11) on us-west-2; will report back on health checks
ci-bot: Canary smoke tests ✅ (3/3)
release-manager: leaving this thread open until canary finishes and we put the release note entry in the changelog
maria: thanks everyone, will follow up with changelog PR and link to ENG-1289
ci-bot: Canary finished: healthy — promote to staging -> production schedule queued during change window 02:00-03:00 UTC
release-manager: scheduling prod rollout in change window, no rollback expected. If anything shows up we revert to commit f2a9c3b and notify the channel
jess: adding the release note and tagging the release in the repo: `git tag -a v2.8.0 -m "v2.8.0: staging patch - eslint pin" b7d4e11`
deploybot: Release tagged v2.8.0 (b7d4e11). Deploy sequence complete for staging, production rollout scheduled. :white_check_mark:
